data.long_meaning: The name Arohi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arh’ which means ‘to reach’ or ‘goal’. The suffix ‘hi’ in Arohi means ‘moving towards’. This name is used to describe someone who is always moving towards their goal, determined and focused. The name Arohi carries the meaning “Moving towards the goal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arohi usually hope their child will grow to embody moving towards the goal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
